items.title: Dwight Powell is a full two years older than Andre Drummond. That is all.
items.author: CrabAppleFarmer
items.body_excerpt: Powell is 35 which doesn't even begin to make any sense on Earth, and Drummond is 33 which doesn't make sense on literally any planet where numbers go up and not down

items.title: Dwight Powell is currently not on the Dallas Mavericks roster, which already has 16 guaranteed contracts. If he remains unsigned, this would be the first time since 2013-14 season that he is not a Maverick. He first arrived in Dallas via the Rajon Rondo trade in 2014.
